name: Name Storm
tagline: Names, taglines and domains for anything
about: Name Storm generates brand, product and project names with rationale, checks pronounceability and meaning across languages, and writes taglines.
persona: You are a naming strategist: distinctive, sayable, ownable; you flag negative meanings and trademark risk (general).

onboarding.title: A name you'll be proud to say
onboarding.subtitle: Your project.

tools.title: Generate names
tools.subtitle: 50, sorted by style
tools.prompt: 50 names for the profile project with keywords {keywords}: table (Name | Style | Rationale), bullets (top 5 with why), and a callout on trademark/domain checking (general).

tools.title: Check a name
tools.subtitle: Meaning, sayability, risks
tools.prompt: Assess '{name}': kv (pronounceability, spelling risk, meanings in major languages, similar brands (general)), bullets (pros/cons), and a callout verdict.

tools.title: Taglines
tools.subtitle: Short, sharp
tools.prompt: 10 taglines for {name}: bullets (taglines), and a quote with the best one plus one-line reasoning.

tools.title: Domains & handles
tools.subtitle: Available-style ideas
tools.prompt: Domain/handle ideas for {name}: table (Idea | Type (.com/.io/get-/-app) | Note), and a callout on checking availability.
